questions.text: Which number should dominate the dashboard: outstanding crates per customer or the weekly increase?
questions.hint: Determines the main visual and ranking logic.

questions.text: Should each customer's balance be compared to last week, to the start of the season, or to a norm?
questions.hint: Sets the reference line for judging whether a balance is rising.

questions.text: Do you think per customer, per driver, or per delivery in the overview?
questions.hint: Decides the primary grouping and drill-down in the dashboard.

questions.text: Is there a fixed moment each week when the crate overview must be ready?
questions.hint: Anchors the refresh schedule and the weekly cycle.

questions.text: Should the dashboard headline the 1,800 vs 950 gap or the 850-crate difference?
questions.hint: Picks the number that makes the value instantly visible.
